Credit of Shares of Shifa International
Hospitals Limited (SIHL) to the Shareholders
of Shifa Medical Centre Islamabad
(Pvt.)Limited (SMCI)
The shareholders of SiHL (including those who were
epreviously shareholders of SMcl) are hereby
informed that in accordance with the Scheme of
Arrangement （the Scheme),for the merger of SMCI
with and intoSIHL,which hasbeen sanctionedbythe
Honourable Islamabad High Court in Companies
Original No.02 of 2026,shares of SIHL have been
allotted infavourof the entitledshareholdersofSMCI
being the members of SMCI other than SIHL or its
nominees,existing as of the Record Date（being July
01,2025）),onthebasisofa swapratioof1ordinary
share of SMCI for every 0.032 sharesofSIHLheld by
such shareholders of SMCl.Furthermore,the
respective entitlements of shares of SiHL have been
credited to the respective accounts of the
shareholders of SMCI which are maintained with the
Central Depository Company of Pakistan Limited.
Pursuant to the above allotment of sharesby SIHL to
the shareholders of SMCl as per the sanctioned
Scheme,SMCl standsdissolvedwithoutwindingup.
